standard_prerequisites.use: Compares two choices of A by a structure-preserving quasi-isomorphism.

core_obligations: Choose the Tate resolution R -> A -> S; B = A (x)_R T computes Tor.
Present T as a quotient of a polynomial algebra; B is a quotient of the DGA A[y_j] whose homology sits in degree 0.
Transfer the DP structures via base-change-div and descend to H(B) = Tor via dpdga-good.
Independence: a second choice A' admits a structure-preserving map A -> A' (uniqueness lemma); the induced quasi-isomorphism B -> B' preserves products and divided powers on Tor.
proof_roadmap: Route the construction through the four named lemmas and prove independence via the comparison map.
difficulty_reason: A routing proof: the content is the correct assembly order of the four in-chapter inputs plus the independence argument.
